thought.text: Android loads cache but blocks scripts. Let force no-cache:

reasoning_content:
The Android is fetching the HTML but NOT the JavaScript assets - it gets 304 (not modified, cached). So the assets ARE being loaded from cache.

This is the issue! Android Chrome is using cached old HTML that still has ES6 modules with `crossorigin`, but blocking the scripts due to CORS.

The fix is to force a cache refresh. Let me add cache-busting headers:
